statement:
For dimensions $d\ge 3$, it is conjectured that, for all relevant integers $n$ and arbitrary real coefficients $\alpha_R$,
\[
n^{(d-2)/2}\left\lVert\sum_{|R|=2^{-n}}\alpha_R h_R\right\rVert_{L^\infty([0,1]^d)}\gtrsim 2^{-n}\sum_{|R|=2^{-n}}|\alpha_R|,
\]
where $h_R$ is an $L^\infty$-normalized $d$-dimensional Haar function adapted to the dyadic rectangle $R\subset[0,1]^d$.
